title: Carry the conditions with the good idea
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Recover the original problem — Ask what the practice was designed to change.; Separate principle and form — Identify the mechanism beneath the visible arrangement.; Compare the conditions — Check resources, constraints, and maintenance needs.; Run a bounded trial — Inspect the intended effect and decide whether to adapt..
